nodes.label: New visual work
nodes.rationale: Flow for making a new surface or replacing a visual identity. PRODUCT.md owns product truth, DESIGN.md owns durable visual decisions. Preserves product truth over polishing.

nodes.label: Onboarding review
nodes.rationale: Instructions for teaching users how to build a surface from scratch, ensuring they learn the patterns and constraints of the codebase, not just receiving completed code.

nodes.label: Operational UI Review
nodes.rationale: Guidance on how to evaluate and improve forms, settings, and dashboards, focusing on clarity, error handling, layout, and data density.

nodes.label: Performance Optimization
nodes.rationale: Techniques and checks for improving UI performance, including reducing layout shifts, lazy loading, animating cleanly, and simplifying DOM structures.

nodes.label: Extraordinary UI (Overdrive)
nodes.rationale: Strategies for pushing UI design past normal boundaries into highly polished, memorable experiences using webGL, advanced CSS, physics-based motion, and novel interactions.

nodes.label: UI Polish Foundation
nodes.rationale: Core principles for refining raw UI into professional quality. Covers spacing systems, typography hierarchy, meaningful color usage, and consistent interaction states.

nodes.label: Quiet Design Approach
nodes.rationale: Techniques for reducing visual noise, creating focus, and clarifying hierarchy. Often involves removing borders, softening contrast, and relying on whitespace.

nodes.label: LLM Skill Routing
nodes.rationale: Rules governing when and how the impeccable skill should be invoked, defining its boundaries and triggering conditions.

nodes.label: Shaping / UX Architecture
nodes.rationale: Guidance for defining the core structure, IA, and interaction model of a feature before visual polish begins.

nodes.label: Typography Guidelines
nodes.rationale: Rules for pairing fonts, setting line heights, sizing text responsively, and managing typographic color/weight for readability.

nodes.label: Data Visualization Design
nodes.rationale: Principles for creating accessible, clear, and aesthetically pleasing charts and data displays within a UI system.

nodes.label: Landing Page Skill
nodes.rationale: Configuration or prompt instructions for generating or auditing landing pages.

nodes.label: Centro de Soldagem Mendes
nodes.rationale: Product truth file defining the welding school target audience (Brazilians in Japan), purpose (training for higher wages), and stack (React/Vite/Tailwind).

nodes.label: Local Run Instructions
nodes.rationale: Basic setup and run instructions, noting the Gemini API key requirement.

nodes.label: Elementor Export Guide
nodes.rationale: Instructions for recreating the React landing page in WordPress using Elementor Pro, covering JSON imports and custom code injection.

nodes.label: React to Elementor Implementation Plan
nodes.rationale: Details the 11 components to convert from a Taildwind/Framer Motion React app to Elementor.

nodes.label: index.html Entry Point
nodes.rationale: Main HTML file defining meta tags, OpenGraph data, and the root div for the React app.

nodes.label: Replit Project Overview
nodes.rationale: Summary of the project stack (React 19, Vite, Tailwind v4, GenAI API, Framer Motion) originally exported from Google AI Studio.
